name: 156. Sampling range and retrieval shape live pins (sampling and retrieval pins)
description: [EXPECT-4XX] pins for the two partial rows whose remaining variant is deterministic: Gemini sampling values outside the documented range (a 2xx would mean Bifrost clamped or dropped the field) and the retrieval.dynamicRetrievalConfig shape on Vertex (not a valid Vertex tool shape; the rejection proves the tool reached Google). Exact wording is confirmed on the first live run.

item.name: 156.1 [EXPECT-4XX] gemini-2.5-flash native temperature out of range reaches Google (gemini sampling)

exec: pm.test('Google rejects the out-of-range temperature and names it', function () { var t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'expected Google’s 400 validation error: ' + t).to.equal(400); pm.expect(t, 'an authentication error proves nothing about the parameter: ' + t).to.not.match(/API key|API_KEY_INVALID|UNAUTHENTICATED|PERMISSION_DENIED|authentication credentials/i); pm.expect(t, 'rejection does not name the out-of-range temperature; field may not have reached Google: ' + t).to.match(/temperature/i); });

item.name: 156.2 [EXPECT-4XX] gemini-2.5-flash native topP out of range reaches Google (gemini sampling)

exec: pm.test('Google rejects the out-of-range topP and names it', function () { var t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'expected Google’s 400 validation error: ' + t).to.equal(400); pm.expect(t, 'an authentication error proves nothing about the parameter: ' + t).to.not.match(/API key|API_KEY_INVALID|UNAUTHENTICATED|PERMISSION_DENIED|authentication credentials/i); pm.expect(t, 'rejection does not name the out-of-range topP; field may not have reached Google: ' + t).to.match(/top.?p/i); });

item.name: 156.4 [EXPECT-4XX] vertex/gemini-2.5-flash retrieval.dynamicRetrievalConfig is not a valid tool shape and reaches Google (vertex dynamic retrieval)

exec: pm.test('Google rejects the retrieval shape and names it', function () { var t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'expected Google’s 400 validation error: ' + t).to.equal(400); pm.expect(t, 'an authentication error proves nothing about the parameter: ' + t).to.not.match(/API key|API_KEY_INVALID|UNAUTHENTICATED|PERMISSION_DENIED|authentication credentials/i); pm.expect(t, 'rejection does not name the retrieval shape; field may not have reached Google: ' + t).to.match(/retrieval|dynamic/i); });
